name: vision
text: Vision is a cross-reference entry. It directs the reader to the Aisling article. Aisling is a form of Irish vision-poetry. A woman-poet figure appears in the dream-vision. MacKillop pairs vision with the Otherworld entry and treats the headword as a pointer to the wider dream-vision record that sits under Vision Literature.

attributes.attribute: MacKillop pointer to the Otherworld headword and the Vision Literature survey

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
